name: bt5-n2build-desktop-web
title: Build targets stage 5: target descriptors, n2build (build, doctor, run), the desktop player, and Windows, Linux and web as targets
issue: User request, 2026-11-10: 'I would like for the engine to be able to allow the user to select a build target in the engine editor UI like windows, linux, android, ios, web, and maybe other console toolchains in the future like switch'. Design and stage table: orchestrator/proposals/build-targets-design.md. Stage 5 of section 5.
acceptance: n2build builds Windows, Linux and web packages from a project, prebuilt and from-source (D3), with JSON progress lines
n2build doctor reports each missing toolchain with how to fix it; descriptors pin toolchain versions
Descriptors are read from targets/ and from extra folders in user settings
CI builds its packages through n2build
gate: needs the user's go; depends on bt4-vfs-packs
notes: Reviewer: descriptors are data, not code paths in n2build; nothing target-specific hard-coded in the tool.
